units.source_text: 弁君又走到薰君那里，薰君把大女公子如何顽强、始终不肯会面之情详细告诉了她。

en.t: Ben no Kimi went back to Kaoru, and Kaoru told her in detail how stubborn the elder princess had been, refusing to meet him to the end.

units.source_text: 弁君埋怨大女公子用心太深，行为太不讲理，气得发昏了，对薰君十分同情。

en.t: Ben no Kimi reproached the elder princess for being too calculating and utterly unreasonable; she was nearly dizzy with anger and felt deep sympathy for Kaoru.

units.source_text: 薰君对她说道：“以前大小姐待我冷酷，我以为还有好转的希望，所以做种种计划，借以自慰。

en.t: Kaoru said to her, "Before, when the elder lady treated me coldly, I thought there was still hope that matters might improve, so I made all sorts of plans to console myself.

units.source_text: 然而今夜实在太可耻了，我很想投河自尽呢。

en.t: But tonight has been truly shameful, and I feel like throwing myself into the river to die.

units.source_text: 亲王临终时舍不得两位小姐，向我谆谆嘱咐，我体谅他的苦心，所以不曾径自出家为僧。

en.t: At his death, the prince could not bear to leave the two young ladies behind and earnestly entrusted them to me; understanding his anguish, I did not simply take holy vows and become a monk.

units.source_text: 今后我对两位都不再有所企望了。

en.t: From now on, I will no longer place any hopes in either of them.

units.source_text: 只是大小姐对我的冷酷，我铭刻于心，始终不能忘怀。

en.t: Only the elder lady's cruelty toward me is engraved on my heart, and I can never forget it.

units.source_text: 匂亲王恬不知耻地前来求婚。

en.t: Prince Niou has come shamelessly to ask for her hand.

units.source_text: 我推想大小姐在打主意：反正要结婚，不如嫁个身份较高的人。

en.t: I suppose the elder lady is thinking that if she must marry anyway, she may as well marry someone of higher rank.

units.source_text: 如此想来，她看不起我更是理之当然，我实在可耻，今后没有面目再来和你们相见了。

en.t: When I think of it that way, it is all the more natural that she should look down on me; I am truly ashamed, and from now on I have no face to come and meet you again.

units.source_text: 我这等愚蠢的行径，至少请你们不要告诉别人！”

en.t: At least, please do not tell anyone else about this foolish conduct of mine!"

units.source_text: 他发了一阵牢骚之后，迥异寻常地急匆匆回京去了。

en.t: After airing his grievances for a while, he hurried back to the capital with an agitation quite unlike his usual manner.
